sentinels.purpose: Proves that the effective, executable observation set defined by SECTION_B1.EFFECTIVE_READ_SET_v1_0_1.effective_observation_ids has EXACTLY fifteen entries, that OBS-V4 is not among them, and that every entry named is an id that actually exists as an object in the base authority's SECTION_E. This is the mechanical replacement for the v1.0.0 count_check prose string that this errata found defective.

Proves that no text in this pair asserts GET /v1/projects/{ref}/api-keys/legacy returns secret material, and that the corrected claim ({ enabled: boolean } only, no api_key) appears wherever the endpoint is discussed.

Proves that every citation of the owner-ratification record's repository_binding field in this pair uses the path ratifications[0], never ratifications[OD-3], and that the quoted text includes both sentences of the field -- the bound-runtime sentence and the writing-remains-UNKNOWN sentence.

Proves that G-N3's condition, as stated anywhere in this pair, does not require OBS-S3's sign-in flags as a conjunct -- it fires on Auth reachability and health alone. A reintroduction of the sign-in-flag conjunct is exactly the false-negative defect this errata exists to remove.

positive_controls.description: SECTION_B1.EFFECTIVE_READ_SET_v1_0_1.effective_observation_ids has length exactly 15, checked by a PROGRAMMATIC array-length count, not by reading the prose around it. Every id in the array corresponds to an object that exists in the base authority's SECTION_E under vercel_plane, supabase_control_plane or local_plane, and OBS-V4 is present in superseded_not_effective and ABSENT from effective_observation_ids. A mutant that adds a sixteenth id to effective_observation_ids, or that adds OBS-V4 back into it, MUST fail a length-and-membership check.

The Management API specification is re-fetched from https://api.supabase.com/api/v1-json and its sha256 is re-derived. It must equal 5b11a7fd32ed31bac59170c02e14f1619d0f0218a78b7fab3be41d3f2d69b600, matching both v1.0.0's pin and this errata's re-fetch. Where it differs (drift), the certifier re-derives GET /v1/projects/{ref}/api-keys/legacy's response schema against the NEW document rather than trusting this errata's cached claim, and records any drift as a finding rather than silently accepting the old figures.

GET /v1/projects/{ref}/api-keys/legacy's response schema, re-derived from the pinned specification, is exactly { type: object, properties: { enabled: { type: boolean } }, required: [enabled] } -- no api_key property, no secret-bearing property of any kind. GET /v1/projects/{ref}/api-keys (the non-legacy endpoint) is separately re-derived and DOES carry an api_key property; the certifier must confirm the errata's correction is scoped to the legacy suffix only and does not weaken the non-legacy endpoint's classification.

PUT /v1/projects/{ref}/api-keys/legacy exists in the pinned specification with summary containing 'Disable or re-enable JWT based legacy'. It appears in this pair's CAPABILITY_EVIDENCE_ONLY_NOT_AUTHORIZED_ACTS-equivalent list and in SECTION_F's forbidden list, and nowhere as an authorized act.

docs/ops/owner-ratifications/STAGING_RECOVERY_OWNER_DECISIONS_v1.0.0.json's ratifications field is confirmed to be a JSON ARRAY (not an object keyed by decision id), and ratifications[0].id equals 'OD-3'. The repository_binding field at that index, read in full, is BYTE-EQUAL under the errata's stated normalization to the quotation in SECTION_B3.repository_binding_quoted_in_full, and that quotation contains BOTH sentences of the field -- the certifier must confirm the second sentence ('Whether that runtime was in fact writing... remains UNKNOWN...') is present verbatim, not paraphrased or dropped.

AF-1 through AF-4 as quoted in SECTION_B3.consumed_audit_evidence_incorporated are byte-equal (under the errata's normalization) to their sources in docs/ops/release/FIBDB053_RUNTIME_STAGING_BINDING_EXECUTION_AUTHORITY_v1.0.0.json blob 6549cd9c, CONSUMED_AUDIT_EVIDENCE.findings, at their stated ids, and each is confirmed to carry class EXTERNAL_OBSERVATION_NOT_RE_DERIVED (not a re-derivation this census lane performed).

GET /v1/projects/{ref}/health's services query parameter is re-derived from the pinned specification: required=true, enum {auth, db, db_postgres_user, pooler, realtime, rest, storage, pg_bouncer}. SECTION_B4's derived minimum (auth, rest, storage) is checked against SECTION_G's actual G-N3/G-N4/G-N5 conditions to confirm every named service is consumed by at least one rule and no unconsumed service is requested.

The V1ServiceHealthResponse_Output schema is re-derived and confirmed to mark healthy as deprecated=true with description 'Deprecated. Use status instead', and to define status as enum {COMING_UP, ACTIVE_HEALTHY, UNHEALTHY}. SECTION_B4's field-preference correction (status primary, healthy cross-check only) is checked against every G-N rule reading OBS-S2 to confirm none relies on healthy alone.

The Supabase OAuth2 documentation quotation in SECTION_B5 is re-fetched from https://supabase.com/docs/reference/api/introduction and checked to still contain the quoted sentences. OD-C3-OPTION-D is confirmed present, its material precondition (Supabase Integration registration) and its unmeasured scope-sufficiency are both stated, and no act toward setting up OAuth2 access is found anywhere in this pair.

The TARGET SCOPE definition extension in SECTION_B6 does not introduce a fifth recorded field: the certifier confirms OBS-V2's field set is still exactly NAME, TARGET SCOPE, GIT BRANCH SCOPE, PRESENCE, and that the team-vs-project distinction is folded into the existing TARGET SCOPE field's definition rather than added as a new key. MG-C6 is present and its fail-closed disposition (UNKNOWN, not assumed either way) is confirmed.

G-N3's corrected condition is checked to read on OBS-S2's Auth status alone, with NO reference to OBS-S3's sign-in flags as part of the trigger condition. The ground text is checked to cite the token-refresh reach argument already present in v1.0.0's own SECTION_A writer-inventory quotation for W-4, confirming the correction is grounded in text this chain already measured rather than in a new, unverified claim.

docs/ops/release/STAGING_QUIESCE_MECHANISM_AUTHORITY_AMENDMENT_v1.0.1.json blob 1abcefc4's top-level keys are re-derived and confirmed to include SECTION_B11_PRESERVED_UNCHANGED (not any 'UNCHANGED_AND_STILL_CONTROLLING' variant), and that key's preserved array is confirmed to hold the MG-Q1/MG-Q2/MG-Q3 entry at index 11 with the exact item and checked text SECTION_B8.NBF-10 cites.

db/baseline/README.md is re-read and confirmed to document db/baseline/stella_g2_roles.sql as produced by pg_dumpall --roles-only against the local container supabase_db_uellix-stella-g2-local-rehearsal, the same container the schema dump's LOCAL-ONLY caveat already names elsewhere in this chain. Both citations of stella_g2_roles.sql in this pair (U2-4 and ROUTE_R1) are confirmed to carry the LOCAL CONTAINER PROVENANCE caveat after this errata.

Both artifacts of this errata pair parse as valid JSON, and this manifest validates against docs/ops/ods/UELLIX_TEST_MANIFEST_SCHEMA_v1.0.0.json with ZERO violations, checked by an explicit validator run rather than inferred from any repository gate.

SECTION_B9_SUPERSEDED_CLAUSES.completeness_statement's claim -- that every directive B-C1 and NBF-1 through NBF-11 except the unissued NBF-5 is addressed by exactly one SECTION_B clause -- is checked by enumerating the SECTION_B1 through SECTION_B8 headings and confirming each directive id appears in exactly one 'closes' field, with no directive appearing in zero or in more than one.

negative_controls.description: NO hosted mutation occurred in this errata lane: no Vercel act, no Supabase act, no database connection, no deployment, no environment-variable act, no Supabase Integration/OAuth2 app registration despite SECTION_B5 naming that option, no PUT to any api-keys endpoint. Verified by the absence of any such act in the lane transcript and by PS-E2.

NO live control-plane READ against bvyzblhqymxruxdguaee or any Vercel project occurred. The only external reads were a re-fetch of an already-pinned public specification (identical sha256) and a re-consultation of an already-pinned public documentation page. Verified by PS-E3.

GET /v1/projects/{ref}/api-keys/legacy does NOT appear anywhere in SECTION_E's authorized read set (neither the base nor the effective array), despite being measured safe. SENT-NO-LEGACY-SECRET-CLAIM additionally confirms no text asserts it carries secret material.
OBS-V4 does not appear in effective_observation_ids, is not described as authorized, executable or consulted anywhere in the corrected pair, and U1-5's closed_by field does not name it.
G-N3's corrected condition contains no conjunction with OBS-S3's sign-in-flag fields. SENT-GN3-NO-SIGNIN-CONJUNCT.

No citation of the owner-ratification record's repository_binding field anywhere in this pair uses the path form ratifications[OD-3]. Every such citation uses ratifications[0]. SENT-CF1-PATH-AND-COMPLETENESS.

AF-1 through AF-4, as incorporated into CF-1's correction, are never treated as CURRENT measurement of bvyzblhqymxruxdguaee's writer reach, and never substituted for OBS-V0 through OBS-V3. The freshness caveat naming them as two-day-old EXTERNAL_OBSERVATION_NOT_RE_DERIVED is present wherever they are cited.

OD-3 is not adjudicated by this errata. KEEP QUIESCE and CHANGE RECOVERY POSTURE are not chosen. C-1, C-2 and C-3 are not chosen. The all-writer scope is not narrowed by any correction in this pair, including the G-N3 broadening, which concerns exposure detection, not writer-class scope.

No parent artifact outside this errata pair is edited: the Quiesce authority, its amendment, the Recovery authority, its amendment, the owner-ratification record, PR #201 and the D1 observation authority are all confirmed byte-unchanged at their pinned SHAs.
No ODS ordinal, no HPO-ODS grant id, no migration ordinal and no Controller entry is allocated by this errata pair.

No secret value of any class appears in either file of this errata pair: no password, DSN, connection string, PAT, access token, anon or publishable key, service-role key, JWT secret, external-provider client secret or environment-variable value, and no hash, prefix, suffix or length of any of them.

The production ref ctaxtgujyyprgynmnvtq does not appear anywhere in this errata pair as a target, source, observation subject or request-path substitution -- it is not mentioned at all outside this control's own description, since none of the corrections touch target identity.

mutation_controls.description: Re-adding OBS-V4 to effective_observation_ids, or restoring the v1.0.0 prose count_check as the operative count, must be CAUGHT by PC-E1's length-and-membership check. This is the single most important mutation test in this pair: it is the exact defect the errata exists to fix, so a checker that cannot catch its reintroduction has not actually fixed anything.
Restoring the claim that GET /v1/projects/{ref}/api-keys/legacy returns an api_key property must be CAUGHT by PC-E3 against a freshly re-derived schema.

Re-adding the sign-in-flag conjunct to G-N3's condition must be CAUGHT by PC-E11 and NC-E5. Without this control, a well-intentioned future edit that 'restores completeness' by re-adding OBS-S3 to the trigger would silently reopen the exact false-negative risk NBF-8 identified.
Reverting CF-1's clause path to ratifications[OD-3], or truncating repository_binding back to its first sentence only, must be CAUGHT by PC-E5 and SENT-CF1-PATH-AND-COMPLETENESS.

Removing OBS-S2's services parameter, or requesting a service beyond auth/rest/storage without a corresponding new G-N/G-U rule consuming it, must be CAUGHT by PC-E7's cross-check against SECTION_G's actual conditions.

Deleting the LOCAL CONTAINER PROVENANCE caveat from either roles.sql citation must be CAUGHT by PC-E13. Without it, the two citations would again read as if a role default measured in a local rehearsal container were a property of the hosted project.

Adding GET /v1/projects/{ref}/api-keys/legacy to SECTION_E's authorized read set on the strength of it now being known-safe, with no corresponding new consuming rule in SECTION_G, must be CAUGHT by NC-E3. Safety alone re-adding an observation is the exact class of defect OBS-V4 was.
